datasheet.title: Panduit Basic Power Distribution Units (PDUs) specification sheet PUSP26-WW-ENG 5/2024

description: Panduit P24B14M basic rack PDU, 0U full: a 1750 mm strip for a cabinet's vertical channel. It has a fixed 3 m cord ending in an IEC 60309 3P+E 9h 60 A plug, three-phase delta, 200-240 V. It has 24 outlets, 12 IEC C13 and 12 IEC C19, in six blocks of four. Each block is on a 20 A double-pole breaker across two of the three lines. It has no display, no network jack and no metering.

gaps.note: the drawing dimensions 52.0 on the cord's side view and 53.0 on the top view, and the Basic PDU sheet gives 2.0 in (50.8) wide and 2.1 in (53.34) deep; no document says which drawn figure is the body's width. The strip is drawn 52 wide and 53 deep.

banks.note: drawing - the front view labels each of the six outlet blocks 'B1' to 'B6' with a colour, [DARK GRAY], [LIGHT GRAY], [WHITE], [DARK GRAY], [LIGHT GRAY], [WHITE], and each of the six breaker plates 'B1' to 'B6'. THAT BLOCK Bk IS FED BY BREAKER Bk IS A READING OF THE LABELS: no sentence held says it. Each plate prints the lines it is across: L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1, L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1. The three greys are drawn as #55585c, #9a9da1 and #e4e5e7 and are estimates of the words: no photograph is held.

capability.note: datasheet - the drawing's unit type is BASIC and the 'Basic Power Distribution Units (PDUs)' sheet lists no metering or switching for the basic line, so `metering-scope: none` and `outlet-switching: false`.

chassis.note: drawing - 1750.0 long (top view) and 53.0 deep (top view, beside the far end); the sheet's 'Basic Power Distribution Units' table gives 2.0 in (50.8 mm) wide and 2.1 in (53.34) deep, and the drawing's 52.0 is dimensioned on the cord's side view. The width is taken as the 52.0 and the depth as the 53.0; the drawing does not say which of its figures is the body width (gaps: body-width). Weight 10.8 kg is the drawing's.

colour.note: estimated - the drawing's title block says MATERIAL/COLOR: N/A and the sheet states no housing colour, so the body is drawn a dark neutral. THE PLATE, MOULDING, SCREW AND LAMP-WINDOW COLOURS ARE NOT CHECKED against any source; no photograph is held.

ends.note: drawing - the cord end carries the gland and cord; the far end is a plain closed line. The cord end is drawn as the gland alone.

front.note: drawing - the front view. From the cord end: a plate with the maker's wordmark, two small screws and the earth screw with its symbol; then, in three pairs, two breaker plates followed by two outlet blocks of four. Each block is a moulding with a lamp window beside every outlet. The outlet and plate positions are read from the front view; the outlet pitch is not dimensioned.

input.note: drawing - 'INPUT PLUG: IEC 60309 3P+E 9H 60A', 'INPUT CORD LENGTH: 3m [10']', 'INPUT VOLTAGE: 200-240VAC, DELTA', 'INPUT CURRENT: 60A (48A DERATED)', 'RATED POWER: 17.3kVA'. The cord is one part at the cord end; its length and the plug's face are not drawn. A kW figure (note 5, 'MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE INPUT POWER = 17.3 kW') and the kVA figure differ in unit and are not reconciled, so no capacity is stated.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S VECTOR DRAWING. Panduit customer drawing P24B14M_DC rev 01B (08/21/2017) is a vector sheet drawn to no stated scale, with a front, rear, top (long side) and side (cord) view. Its scale was taken from its own 1750.0 overall dimension (the 1555.0 between the buttons agrees), and every position was read off renderings of the front view at 600 and 800 dpi, to about 1 mm across and 3 mm along the strip. The library draws the PDU STANDING, cord end down, so a position along the drawing becomes 1750 minus that, and a position across becomes x. No photograph and no 3D model of the part is held.

mount.note: `rack-side`: the strip stands beside a rack's upright on two mounting buttons on its back, 1555.0 apart and 40.5 from the cord end (rear view). The drawing says 'VERTICAL, 0U FULL' and gives no count of units; `ru: 39` is the whole units the 1750 mm length covers (39.4) and is not stated by any document.

outlets.note: drawing - 'OUTLET QTY&TYPE: (12) C13, (12) C19' and the receptacle block, 'IEC 60320/C19 16 A' and 'IEC 60320/C13 10 A'. Each outlet is std/c13-outlet@1 or std/c19-outlet@1. The kind and the way up of each is read off the front view; the C19s of the first block of a pair are drawn earth side to the left and those of the second block earth side to the right. THE DRAWN OUTLET SYMBOLS ARE SMALLER THAN THE REGISTRY'S WELLS (a drawn C19 pair is 32.9 apart against a 35.6 well, a drawn C13 27 across against a 30.4 well), so the library's wells cannot all stand on the drawn centres: the C19 pairs are drawn 35.7 apart, the C13 pairs 0.1 to 1.6 mm from their drawn centres, an ESTIMATE of the drawing's own reading error and not a source (gaps: outlet-size).

rear.note: drawing - the rear view: two buttons 40.5 from the cord end and 1555.0 apart, on the strip's centre line. '(2) PL 24.0' locates two further marks and '(2) PL O18.4' the buttons; the further marks are not drawn (gaps: rear-marks).

sides.note: drawing - the top view is the long side; it draws a row of small marks, not read here. The side view is the cord's, not the strip's.
